$comment: MACHINE-READABLE TASK MANIFEST for the multilingual program. Schema is I18N-PLAN.md section 14,
plus ONE addition: every record carries a 'status' field ('todo' | 'in_progress' | 'done').
Section 14 does not define 'status'; it is added here because the program is executed by
successive ultracode runs that need to know what already landed without re-deriving it from git.
THE INVARIANT (section 14): files_owned sets are DISJOINT across any two units that can run
concurrently, and a unit may never edit a file it does not own. Where two units genuinely must
touch one file, they are serialized with a depends_on edge instead of being allowed to race.
Every such shared file is listed under $sharedFileChains below with the chain that orders it.
'blocks' is the exact inverse of 'depends_on' and is generated, not hand-maintained: if A appears
in B.depends_on then B appears in A.blocks. Validated on every edit (see $validation).
PATH GLOBS: a trailing '/**' means the whole subtree. Overlap is computed by prefix, so
'src/components/**' is treated as colliding with 'src/components/MegaMenu.tsx' and the two owners
are ordered by an edge. Do not add a glob that swallows another unit's file without adding the edge.
PHASE labels are strings, not integers, because the plan has sub-phases (0b Pagefind, 0c hosting
cutover). '11' = section 11 indexer, '13' = section 13 per-language skills, '15' = section 15.4
build isolation. Pagefind units carry phase '0b' (section 12.4 is that phase's checklist).
human_decision is true for exactly two units, per section 18: the Cloudflare custom-domain attach
(P0c-custom-domain-attach) and the service-account key rotation (IDX-key-rotation, decision 7).
Decisions 1-6 were resolved on 2026-08-09, so nothing else is human-gated.
MERGED CHECKBOXES (deliberate, per section 14's 'merge or add an edge' rule):
- Phase 0b's SKIP_PAGEFIND gate is part of P0b-pagefind-plugin, not its own unit.
- Phase 3's static/ dedupe (B3), merged-tree Pagefind run, and two-axis size gate all live in
.github/workflows/deploy.yml, so they are one unit: P3-deploy-workflow.
- Phase 4's bidi isolation, icon flipping and :lang(ja) line-breaking are all src/css/custom.css,
so they are one unit: P4-rtl-css.
- Phase 8's per-locale navbar.json/footer.json checkbox is covered by the P6-translate-<locale>
units (which own all of i18n/<locale>/**) and asserted by P6-ui-string-parity-check.
- Section 11.1's 'confirm the Indexing API is enabled' is part of IDX-notify.
- Section 12.3's extended-release and et/ga/lt UI-string checkboxes are part of the P0b units.
STATUS AS OF 2026-08-11: P1-config-split and P1-locales-config are reported complete by the
orchestrator (concurrent agents in this same checkout) but were not yet flushed to disk when this
manifest was written; both were verified present on disk (config/*.ts, i18n/locales.config.ts)
before this file was finalized. P2-tiers-json and P1-task-manifest were also verified on disk.
Two further units are mid-flight in this same checkout and are marked 'in_progress':
P1-canonical-plugin-harden (plugins/normalize-canonical-urls modified, test file present) and
IDX-auth-quota-ledger (auth/ledger/quota .mjs + tests present, commit-state.sh not yet).
$schemaNote: One record per work unit. Fields: id, phase, title, files_owned, files_touched_readonly, depends_on, blocks, acceptance, parallel_safe, human_decision, status.

$sharedFileChains.scripts/check-content.mjs + check-conten: P1-check-content-i18n owns the code; P13-check-content-lang-config appends config DATA only (section 15.2 collision 3)
$sharedFileChains.src/pages/tools/**: P1-ui-strings -> P7-localize-tools. NOTE: src/pages/about.mdx and contact.md are markdown, not <Translate> call sites, so they belong to P1-anchor-freeze; src/pages/legal/** is English-only in every locale and is owned by nobody.

$validation: Before committing an edit to this file, re-run the four checks it is built on: (1) every depends_on and blocks id resolves to a real unit; (2) blocks is the exact inverse of depends_on (regenerate it, never hand-edit it); (3) the graph is acyclic, i.e. a Kahn topological sort consumes all units; (4) for every pair of units with no dependency path between them in either direction, their files_owned sets are disjoint under PREFIX comparison, so that 'src/components/**' counts as colliding with 'src/components/MegaMenu.tsx'. Checks 3 and 4 are the ones that actually protect the run; 4 is what section 14 calls the rule that makes parallelism safe.
